answer.reason: The verses tell of events at Gibeon: its league with Joshua, its siege and relief, and the LORD's appearing to Solomon there.

clauses.english: won a league with Joshua by posing as ambassadors
clauses.quote: And Joshua made peace with them, and made a league with them

clauses.english: was besieged by five Amorite kings and saved by Joshua
clauses.quote: encamped before Gibeon, and made war against it

clauses.english: was where the LORD appeared to Solomon in a dream
clauses.quote: In Gibeon the LORD appeared to Solomon in a dream by night

doubts: The sun standing still upon Gibeon (JOS 10:12-13) was left out as part of the same battle story as the relief of the city.
